dialogues.speaker: Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency Bulletin Board. You can find notices and messages from passersby posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I sent my apprentice to deliver the medicine you commissioned the day before yesterday. Please take care of yourselves and avoid acting impulsively to avoid these types of injuries."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Thank you for taking care of us, Dr. Baizhu. I'll let those rascals know."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I want to file a complaint! I want to expose the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency as failing to live up to its reputation and bullying their customers!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Three months ago, I entrusted them with sending a letter, a confession filled with my love... but I still haven't received a reply!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The guards must have been negligent and lost my letter!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "The letter you commissioned us to deliver was delivered as requested some time ago. Please accept the reality of the situation."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Hello, I'm truly sorry for bothering all of you during these busy times, but I, Wakamatsu, have been obsessed with the martial arts of Liyue for a long time now and would like to train under the waterfalls like the warriors of old so that I can comprehend the ultimate martial arts..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "If you are willing, I kindly implore you to teach me the secret arts trained under the waterfalls. I thank you sincerely from the bottom of my heart. With great respect."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Haha, this friendly foreigner seems to be under a bit of a mistaken impression. Who would really practice martial arts under a waterfall?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "If you're really interested in martial arts, you should start by practicing horse stance!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I commissioned a delivery of new bamboo from Qingce Village a while ago. Why hasn't it arrived yet?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "The miasma has been a little thick recently, so there have been some delays in shipping times. Please be patient."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Long have I heard of the greatness of the martial arts skills of the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency's guards. I too know a little something about spears and cudgels, and would like to pay a visit to consult with your guards regarding such matters. I look forward to being enlightened."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Apologies. The Secure Transport Agency's guards are busy with work and don't have time for friendly sparring matches. Please try again another time."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Alas, I caused you all a lot of trouble before. If that young Gaming fellow hadn't rescued me, I'm afraid these old bones would already be part of the mountains..."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "The wild beasts seem to be more active than usual recently. Considering your age, you should try not to go too deep into the mountains alone unless you really have to."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Friends, are you eager to explore the rich history of Liyue's martial arts? Do you want to experience the soul-stirring feeling of being a heroic swordsman?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "You're in luck, because now's your chance! Wangshan Hall, the stronghold of the Guhua Clan for a thousand years, is now open to the public, and we sincerely invite chivalrous heroes from all walks of life to come and visit!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Don't miss out, you might never get another chance! Interested parties should visit the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency to make arrangements!"

dialogues.speaker: Recruitment Notice
dialogues.text: Looking for guards to hire. Food and accommodation are provided. Pay excellent.

dialogues.speaker: Recruitment Notice
dialogues.text: Applicants must be physically fit and capable of enduring hardship and hard labor. Interested parties should come to the Secure Transport Agency for details.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Huh? Hired muscle in Liyue also moonlights doing artistic performance gigs?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "What's that called again... Uh, Wushou Dance?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Haha, if you spot one of our people taking part, there's no need to be surprised... After all, who doesn't enjoy that kind of lively, boisterous atmosphere?"

dialogues.speaker: Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency Advertisement
dialogues.text: Worried that your valuable goods will be robbed by bandits on the road? Worried about being waylaid by wild beasts while traveling alone in the mountains and forests?

dialogues.speaker: Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency Advertisement
dialogues.text: Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency: Delivering all goods safe and sound, and delivering you peace of mind!

dialogues.speaker: Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency Advertisement
dialogues.text: Note: Any and all consequences that arise due to a failure to honestly disclose the contents of cargo will be borne in their entirety by the customer.
